purpose: Select and start exactly one owner-authorized control-plane task from a completed inactive handoff without activating the campaign.

role_display.task_title_rule: Continuation task metadata and start/completion handoffs use an AgentOS Controller title; Bootstrap is not an ongoing task role.
role_display.history_rule: Accepted v1 records from before the display guard remain readable; newly compiled records carry the canonical role fields.

selection.rule: The selected task ID must match exactly one validated CONTROL_PLANE_ONLY candidate.
selection.ambiguous_or_missing: Reject and leave the parent handoff unchanged.

identity: Preserve the canonical Controller campaign identity, project, campaign version, policy, parent reconciliation, and approval-linked evidence.
persistence: Records are content-addressed, bounded to the control-plane root, compare-and-swap protected, written atomically, and read back as JSON.
audit_rule: A completion handoff retains four complete independent report bodies and a clean reconciliation; a summary cannot replace a report body.
stop_conditions: Any campaign, version, policy, identity, parent, scope, or source mismatch.
Any activation, Product write, agent-spawn, deployment, release, push, merge, sterile-copy, secret, or destructive boundary request.
Any missing, ambiguous, summarized-only, malformed, stale, or unreadable record.
undo: Remove the continuation records and revert only the isolated development commit; leave the parent campaign evidence and approval records untouched.
